name: op_amp_inverting_amp
description: Inverting amp, R_in=10k, R_f=100k, VIN=0.1V. DC output = -R_f/R_in · VIN = -1.0V. Closed-loop DC gain = 20 dB. Closed-loop -3 dB point = GBW · β = GBW · 10k/110k ≈ 90.9 kHz.

VOUT.rationale: Ideal inverting: V(OUT) = -(R2/R1)·V(IN) = -10·0.1 = -1.0V. Error at A0=100 dB: |V(IN)|·(1+R2/R1)/A0 ≈ 11 µV.

expected.rationale: DC/passband: 20·log10(R_f/R_in) = 20·log10(10) = 20.0 dB. 100 Hz is well below closed-loop BW ≈ 91 kHz.
Closed-loop -3 dB: GBW · β = 1e6 · (10k/(10k+100k)) = 90.909 kHz. Expected magnitude = 20 - 3 = 17 dB.
